summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Sir Anthony Jackson (1599–1666), an English lawyer and soldier of the seventeenth century. It describes his service as a cavalier during the English Civil War, his knighthood from Charles II, his participation in the Battle of Worcester, and an imprisonment in the Tower of London lasting more than a decade.
one_line: Biographical entry on Sir Anthony Jackson (1599–1666), a seventeenth-century English lawyer and cavalier soldier knighted by Charles II.
